testCases.name: Loan Application State Machine
testCases.input: BoundedContext Lending { domain { Aggregate LoanApplication { applicationId uuid identity; applicantId string required; requestedAmount decimal min 1000; creditScore int min 300 max 850; status text default DRAFT; submittedAt datetime optional; approvedAt datetime optional. State machine for status has DRAFT initial, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED final, WITHDRAWN final. DRAFT can move to SUBMITTED when applicant data is complete. SUBMITTED can move to APPROVED only when credit score at least 650 and requested amount is under policy limit. SUBMITTED can move to REJECTED when risk too high. DRAFT or SUBMITTED can move to WITHDRAWN always. operations { when submitting application with submittedAt: applicantId requestedAmount and creditScore are required; then status becomes SUBMITTED and submittedAt is copied; emit LoanApplicationSubmitted. when approving application with approvedAt: status is SUBMITTED, creditScore greater than 650, requestedAmount greater than 0; then status APPROVED and approvedAt set; emit LoanApplicationApproved. } } } events { submitted event applicationId uuid submittedAt datetime. approved event applicationId uuid approvedAt datetime. } repositories { LoanApplicationRepository supports findById optional and save. } specifications { ApprovableLoan means status SUBMITTED and creditScore greater than 650. } }

testCases.name: Return Merchandise Authorization
testCases.input: BoundedContext Returns { domain { Aggregate ReturnRequest { returnId uuid identity, orderId uuid required, customerId text required, items list of ReturnLine, reason text required, status text default REQUESTED, requestedAt datetime, inspectedAt datetime nullable, refundAmount Money. nested entity ReturnLine has returnLineId uuid identity, productId text required, quantity int at least 1, condition text required, lineRefund Money. operations { when approving return with inspectedAt: status must be REQUESTED, all items have quantity greater than zero, reason is not empty; then calculate refundAmount as sum of line refunds, status APPROVED, inspectedAt set; emit ReturnApproved. when rejecting return with rejectionReason: status REQUESTED and rejectionReason not empty are required; then status REJECTED; emit ReturnRejected. } } ValueObject Money amount decimal min zero currency required max 3. } events { ReturnApproved returnId uuid refundAmount Money approvedAt datetime. ReturnRejected returnId uuid rejectionReason text rejectedAt datetime. } repositories { ReturnRequestRepository findById optional, findByOrderId list, save void. } }

testCases.name: Support Ticket SLA
testCases.input: BoundedContext Support { domain { Aggregate Ticket { ticketId uuid identity; customerId text required; priority text required; subject text required max 200; status text default OPEN; createdAt datetime required; firstResponseDueAt datetime; resolvedAt datetime optional; messages list of TicketMessage. TicketMessage entity has messageId uuid identity, authorId text required, body text required, createdAt datetime required. operations { when assigning ticket with agentId: ticket is OPEN and agentId not blank; then status ASSIGNED; emit TicketAssigned. when resolving ticket with resolvedAt: status must be ASSIGNED or IN_PROGRESS, there must be at least one message, resolvedAt after createdAt; then status RESOLVED and resolvedAt copied; emit TicketResolved. } } DomainService SlaPolicy { when calculating first response due with priority as String and createdAt as DateTime: then calculate firstResponseDueAt as createdAt plus priority duration. } } events { TicketAssigned ticketId uuid agentId string assignedAt datetime. TicketResolved ticketId uuid resolvedAt datetime. } specifications { OverdueTicket: Ticket where firstResponseDueAt before now and status is not RESOLVED. } }

testCases.name: Course Enrollment Capacity
testCases.input: BoundedContext Learning { domain { Aggregate CourseOffering { offeringId uuid identity, courseCode text required, instructorId text required, capacity int min 1, enrolledStudents set of StudentEnrollment, waitlistedStudents list of StudentEnrollment, status text default DRAFT. StudentEnrollment entity: enrollmentId uuid identity, studentId string required, enrolledAt datetime required, status text. operations { when publishing offering: courseCode instructorId and capacity are required; then status PUBLISHED. when enrolling student with studentId and enrolledAt: status must be PUBLISHED and studentId required and enrolledStudents count below capacity; then create StudentEnrollment with studentId and add it to enrolledStudents; emit StudentEnrolled. when waitlisting student with studentId and enrolledAt: status PUBLISHED and enrolledStudents count is at capacity; then create enrollment and add to waitlistedStudents; emit StudentWaitlisted. } } } events { StudentEnrolled offeringId uuid studentId string enrolledAt datetime. StudentWaitlisted offeringId uuid studentId string waitlistedAt datetime. } repositories { CourseOfferingRepository findById optional, findByCourseCode list, save void. } specifications { OpenForEnrollment means status PUBLISHED and enrolledStudents less than capacity. } }

testCases.name: Procurement Purchase Order
testCases.input: BoundedContext Procurement { domain { Aggregate PurchaseOrder { purchaseOrderId uuid identity; supplierId text required; requesterId text required; lines list of PurchaseOrderLine; totalAmount Money; status text default DRAFT; approvedAt datetime optional. PurchaseOrderLine entity with lineId uuid identity, itemCode text required, quantity int min 1, unitCost Money required. operations { when submitting purchase order: supplier requester and lines are required; calculate total from line costs; status SUBMITTED; emit PurchaseOrderSubmitted. when approving purchase order with approvedAt and approverId: status must be SUBMITTED, approverId required, totalAmount greater than zero; set status APPROVED and approvedAt; emit PurchaseOrderApproved. } } ValueObject Money amount decimal at least zero currency text required max 3. DomainService ApprovalPolicy { when checking approval requirement with totalAmount as Money and requesterId as String: then calculate approvalRequired as totalAmount is greater than 1000. } } events { PurchaseOrderSubmitted id uuid submittedAt datetime total Money. PurchaseOrderApproved id uuid approverId string approvedAt datetime. } factories { PurchaseOrderFactory creates PurchaseOrder from supplierId requesterId and lines requiring lines not empty and returning created order. } }

testCases.name: Event Registration With Complex Flow
testCases.input: BoundedContext Events { domain { Aggregate EventRegistration { registrationId uuid identity; eventId uuid required; attendeeEmail text required and email; attendeeName text required; ticketType text required; status text default RESERVED; expiresAt datetime; checkedInAt datetime optional. operations { when reserving ticket with expiresAt: attendee email, attendee name, event id and ticket type are all required; expiresAt must be within next 30 days; status RESERVED; emit TicketReserved. when confirming registration: status must be RESERVED and expiresAt is after now; then status CONFIRMED; emit RegistrationConfirmed. when checking in with checkedInAt: status must be CONFIRMED and checkedInAt is after now minus 1 day; set status CHECKED_IN and checkedInAt; emit AttendeeCheckedIn. } } } events { TicketReserved registrationId uuid eventId uuid expiresAt datetime. RegistrationConfirmed registrationId uuid confirmedAt datetime. AttendeeCheckedIn registrationId uuid checkedInAt datetime. } repositories { EventRegistrationRepository findById optional, findByEventId list, findByAttendeeEmail list, save void. } specifications { ExpiredReservation where expiresAt before now and status RESERVED. ConfirmedRegistration where status CONFIRMED. } }
